The '''Sienar family''' came from a long line of starship builders. Five millennia before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the Sienars built warships for [[Teta/Legends|Empress Teta]] during the [[Unification Wars (Koros)/Legends|Unification Wars]]. The family earned enough credit to ensure that the Sienar lineage continued into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] era. The family owned and operated the successful starship manufacturing company [[Sienar Technologies]].

A century before the Battle of Yavin the wealthy [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]] industrialist [[Kerred Santhe]] of the [[Santhe family/Legends|Santhe family]] acquired a controlling share in [[Sienar Technologies]] and renamed it [[Santhe/Sienar Technologies]]. The union between the two families was secured during this period with an arranged marriage.
